transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I’m here because, for almost two years now, I’ve been sure that the contractor and some people on my block have been working together, quietly, to cheat us. The kitchen was supposed to be fixed, but it’s still half-wrong, and I don’t think that’s an accident. My husband keeps showing me receipts and they keep giving excuses, but it doesn’t add up to me.
Have you talked to anyone else about these suspicions, and have you had similar concerns in the past?

Yes, I’ve talked to my husband about it a lot. He thinks the receipts explain things, but I don’t agree. I’ve also mentioned it around the block, because I do think some of them know what’s going on. I can’t say I had something exactly like this before, not like this. This has been going on almost two years with the kitchen, and I’m sure it’s being kept wrong on purpose.
Have you had any other situations, outside of the kitchen issue, where you felt people were working against you or involved in some kind of secret plan?

Not really outside of that. It’s mainly this kitchen and the contractor, and I do think some people on the block are tied into it somehow. I know my husband keeps saying the receipts explain it, but to me it still looks like they’re keeping it half-wrong on purpose and making excuses.
Have you ever felt that people you don’t know well or strangers were involved in any kind of plan against you, outside of the situation with the contractor and your neighbors?

No, not really strangers. It’s about the contractor and some people on my block. I’ve felt for nearly two years that they’ve been working together to cheat us and keep the kitchen wrong on purpose, even when my husband shows me receipts or they give excuses.
Can you think of any other situations, even small ones, where you believed people were secretly working against you or involved in a plan that wasn’t obvious to others?

No, I can’t really think of anything separate from that. It’s this kitchen situation. For almost two years I’ve been sure the contractor and some people on my block are quietly working together to cheat us and keep it half-wrong on purpose. My husband keeps showing me receipts and they give their excuses, but that doesn’t change what I’m seeing.
Have you ever felt that someone was interfering with your thoughts, controlling your actions, or that people were not who they really seemed to be?
No, I haven’t felt like anyone was controlling my thoughts or my actions. And I don’t think people are pretending to be someone else or anything like that. It’s not that kind of thing for me.
Have you ever had thoughts that you believed were completely true, but others insisted they weren’t real or didn’t make sense?

Yes. That’s basically why I’m here. I’ve been sure for almost two years that the contractor and some people on my block are working together to cheat us and keep my kitchen wrong on purpose. My husband shows me receipts, and they give reasons or excuses, but to me it still feels obvious what they’re doing.
Have you ever had any other strong beliefs or suspicions that others didn’t share or understand, even if they seemed obvious to you?

Not really anything else, no. It’s mainly this thing with the kitchen. I know other people don’t see it the way I do, but to me it’s clear—the contractor and some people on the block have been working together to cheat us and leave it half-wrong on purpose. My husband keeps showing me receipts and they all have their explanations, but that doesn’t change what I believe is going on.

Even though your husband has shown you receipts and they have given explanations, do you believe, without any doubt, that the contractor and some people on your block are still secretly working together to cheat you and keep the kitchen wrong on purpose?

Yes. I do believe it. I know my husband thinks the receipts explain it, and they all have their reasons, but I don’t buy it. For almost two years now I’ve been sure the contractor and some people on my block are quietly working together to cheat us and keep the kitchen half-wrong on purpose.

Even though there may be explanations or evidence provided by your husband and others, does your belief that the contractor and some people on your block are secretly working against you remain completely unchanged?

Yes, it hasn’t really changed. I know my husband keeps showing me receipts, and they all have explanations, but I still believe the contractor and some people on my block are working together to cheat us and keep the kitchen wrong on purpose. It’s been almost two years, and I still feel sure about it.
Even though there is evidence from your husband and explanations from the contractor, does your belief feel completely certain and unshakable to you?

Yes. It feels certain to me. I know my husband has shown me receipts, and the contractor always has some explanation, but I don’t believe that’s the whole truth. For nearly two years I’ve felt sure they’ve been working together to cheat us and leave my kitchen wrong on purpose.

latest_inference.note: The patient's belief is fixed, unshakable, and circumscribed around a single theme (persecutory delusion related to the kitchen repair and contractor/neighboring individuals). There is no evidence of other psychotic symptoms (e.g., hallucinations, thought insertion, etc.), no mood episodes, no OCD features, and no other pervasive personality traits or disorders. This presentation is most consistent with Delusional Disorder (F22.0). Other candidates such as F20.0, F23.0, F24.0, mood disorders with psychotic features (F31.2, F32.3, F33.3), OCD (F42.2), dissociative disorders (F44.8), and personality disorders (F60.7) are ruled out due to absence of respective core symptoms.
